<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_EmployeeDevelopment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeeDevelopment" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeeds" name="Development needs or career aspirations identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify employee development needs or career aspirations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePlan" name="Manager and HR create personal development plan"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit" name="Continue development and feedback"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Employee works on skill enhancement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FeedbackEvaluation" name="Supervisors provide feedback and evaluate performance"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentJoin" name="Development and feedback completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Milestones" name="Milestones reached?" default="Flow_MilestonesNotReached"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FormalReview" name="HR conducts formal performance review"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewApproval" name="Promotion approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransitionRole" name="Employee transitions into new role"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitioned into new role"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Promotion not approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToIdentify" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeeds" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyToPlan" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreatePlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CreatePlan" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToEnhance" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit" targetRef="Task_FeedbackEvaluation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnhanceToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToJoin" sourceRef="Task_FeedbackEvaluation" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToMilestones" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentJoin" targetRef="Gateway_Milestones"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Milestones" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">milestonesReached</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesNotReached" name="Milestones not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Milestones" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConsiderToReview" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion" targetRef="Task_FormalReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToApproval" sourceRef="Task_FormalReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproval" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalizeToTransition" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="Task_TransitionRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransitionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_TransitionRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
